reasoning_evidence: No IA signed as of 2026-06-01 (FIS requested 2023-06-13, not yet approved — 3+ years waiting). No IA = no contractual transmission date, no milestone clock running.
Construction per application: Jan 2027 – Dec 2027. A 347 MW solar project takes 12-18 months to build. Jan 2027 construction start → earliest realistic COD mid-2028.
One prior COD slip already in record: 2026-10-01 → 2027-12-01 (14 months), before IA or FIS approval.
Capacity nearly tripled from entry (120.6 → 347 MW) while still pre-FIS — scope unclear, could grow further or shrink, adds schedule uncertainty.
No construction milestones achieved. No financing confirmed. No EPC announcement found.
Ch.313 qualifying time period ends 2027-12-31 — strong incentive to maintain stated COD but 347 MW in 11 months from ground-break is aggressive.
BNB Renewables has track record of completed projects (Long Draw, Lamesa etc.) — developer is real and capable, mitigating paper-project risk.
Best case: FIS approved late 2026, IA executed early 2027, construction start mid-2027 → COD late 2028. Base case: 2028-Q2. High-drift scenario: 2029.
